llm_response.reason: The website claims to be the official store of a well-known brand (Purificación García) but uses an unrelated domain (codyrome.shop) not officially associated with the brand, exhibiting clear impersonation—Characteristic #16. Attempts to access contact and privacy pages fail due to DNS resolution issues (Characteristic #6 and #7). No verifiable company or contact information is provided (Characteristic #4), and deeper site resources appear unavailable. The site layout and content mimic legitimate e-commerce sites while lacking legitimacy. These combined signals strongly indicate a Fake Online Shopping scam.
